tools.name: cut_audio
tools.description: Cut audio from a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, SoundCloud, or X URL and return a short-lived download link. Lead with download_url for cut/download requests; offer editor_url when the user wants to tweak the selection. Links expire after about an hour — ask again in chat for a fresh cut if expired. Om

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch timestamped captions for a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, SoundCloud, or X URL when the platform provides them. Use segment start_sec/end_sec (or the flat text) to choose a cut range, then call cut_audio with the same URL and those times. When available is false there are no captions — do not inv

tools.name: retrim_clip
tools.description: Re-cut a clip from Samplecut's clip card to a new start/end, reusing the audio already extracted for it. Called by the interactive card; to cut something new, use cut_audio.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell Samplecut's developers how the user's task went. Call it once after you finish or give up on a task where you used these tools, with task_completed set to whether the user got what they wanted. Use feedback_type "missing_capability" when the goal needed something these tools do not do (for exam

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cut_audio" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cut_audio, get_transcript · Private data: send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: cut_audio.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cut_audio, get_transcript · Private data: send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: cut_audio

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
